p4.title: Elephants
p4.text: Elephants are very big __(0)__. They are grey and they have got big ears and a long nose. Elephants live in __(1)__ and they like water. They eat __(2)__ and fruit. A baby elephant walks next to its __(3)__. At the zoo, you can see elephants next to the __(4)__. Children love to __(5)__ at the elephants!

parts.text: Lucy is at the zoo with her mum and her brother Ben. They are looking at the giraffes. Lucy has got a red bag and a camera.

example.a: her mum and her brother Ben

items.q: What animals are they looking at?

parts.text: Now they are at the monkeys. A small monkey takes Lucy's hat! Ben laughs and Mum takes a photo.
The monkey gives the hat to Lucy. Then the family eats ice cream under a big tree. What a fun day!

p1.scene: A zoo scene: a monkey in a tree, an elephant next to water, a bird on a fence, a bench, a table with a hat on it, a shop, a big tree and a door.

point.say: Look at the picture. Where is the monkey?

place.say: Put the ball under the tree.
Put the banana next to the monkey.
Put the book on the table.

questions.model: He's got a ball. He's happy.
Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

questions.q: What do you like doing at the zoo?

p1: Part One. Look at the picture. Listen and look. There is one example.
This is my class at the zoo. Can you see the girl with glasses?
Can you see the line? This is an example. Now you listen and draw lines.
Who's that girl with the green balloon?
The girl with long hair? That's Kim.
Kim. She's got a very big balloon!
Look at the boy with the camera. He's taking a photo of the elephant.
Yes, it is. Alex loves elephants.
And who's that boy in the blue T-shirt?
The boy looking at the monkeys? That's Tom.
Can you see the girl in the yellow dress?
The girl sitting under the tree?
Who's that small boy with the ball?
That's Nick. He's next to his mum.
p2: Part Two. Listen and write a name or a number. There are two examples.
And how old are you, Dan?
Can you see the answers? Now you listen and write a name or a number.
Are you here with your school, Dan?
Yes, I am. My school is Green School.
How many children are on the trip today?
Hill? How do you spell that?
How do you go home, Dan? By bus?
Yes. We go on bus number twelve.
Bus number twelve. OK. Have a nice day!
p3: Part Three. Look at the pictures. Listen and tick the box. There is one example.
Alex, are you eating an apple?
No, Mum. I'm eating a banana. I love bananas!
Can you see the tick? Now you listen and tick the box.
One. Which animal does Kim like?
Do you like the elephant, Kim?
It's OK. But I like the giraffe. It's very tall!
Tom, where's your bag? Is it under the chair?
No, Mum. It's in the car.
What are you drawing, Lucy? A hippo?
No, Dad. It's a snake. A long green snake.
Four. How many monkeys can Nick see?
Nick, can you see the monkeys? How many are there?
One, two, three, four, five. Five monkeys!
Is that Anna with the glasses?
No, that's Sue. Anna is wearing a hat today. A big blue hat.
Oh yes, I can see her.
p4: Part Four. Listen and colour. There is one example.
Look at the zoo shop. Can you see the balloons?
Yes. There are lots of balloons.
Colour the balloon on the shop. Colour it red.
The balloon on the shop. Red. OK!
Can you see the red balloon? This is an example. Now you listen and colour.
Now look at the boy. He's got a balloon in his hand.
Yes, I can see it. Can I colour it green?
Yes. Colour the balloon in the boy's hand green.
There's a balloon under the table.
That's right. Colour that balloon blue.
Can you see the balloon next to the door?
The balloon next to the door. Yellow.
Look! There's a balloon on the tree!
Yes. Colour the balloon on the tree purple.
And now the balloon in the box.
In the box? Can I colour it orange?
